1|## Chapter 62 — Legacy Systems Review
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Legacy is not about preserving the past unchanged, but about understanding what to carry forward and what to release."* 
     4|*Dr. Arun Patel Jr.: "We don't worship our grandparents' tools. We learn from why they chose them."*\
     5|
     6|The Legacy Systems Review convocation opened not with a ceremonial ignition, but with the quiet power-down of a sterling generator that had served Valles Marineris Colony for thirty-two years. Engineers in protective gear monitored the shutdown sequence not with sadness, but with the professional curiosity of scientists examining a specimen at the end of its useful life.
     7|
